written_by: Editor's list. Not taken from any source. To be corrected by trip reports.

items.item: Hydration pack or two litres of water
items.reason: Heat on open highways dries you out before you feel thirsty

items.item: Mesh jacket or a cooling vest
items.reason: Full gear in summer heat is safer if air moves through it

items.item: A warm layer and a clear visor
items.reason: Winter mornings bring cold and thick fog
Monsoon showers are sudden and heavy
Highway shoulders collect nails and wire
Hours of wind noise tire you faster than the riding does

items.item: Reflective strips or a bright vest
items.reason: Trucks see you late at dusk

items.item: Licence, registration, insurance and pollution certificate
A way to pay tolls where two-wheelers are charged

items.reason: Only if the fuel check says so for your bike
